name: Filing Good: An Office Tidy-Up
summary:
Filing Good: An Office Tidy-Up is a 2D tidying game set in the offices of a cold, minimalist company. Sheets of paper and binders are scattered across the floor around metal shelves. Each sheet shows a symbol and a number: the symbol indicates the shelf slot, and the number indicates the binder. The player files each sheet into its binder, then each binder into its slot. Mistakes are refused but never counted, and there is no time limit.

The game offers four sizes, from 768 to 6,144 sheets, and two floor layouts: a single open space, or separate departments. As an optional progression, the player can hire up to three interns using paper clips earned by completing shelf slots. Interns search the floor for the sheets of the binders they are given, and can be upgraded in speed, energy and capacity.
